I don't like being harassed but I really do want to help out. However since Tor is compromised, what are the alternatives?

Honestly, I am not sure. I think a combination of physical as well as digital privacy could enable greater anonymity. For example, despite TOR being compromised, if you ran your computer on TAILS, got on a public wifi and spoofed your MAC address, ran your connection through a VPN and then used TOR, you would be still fairly digitally anonymous. However, you would have had to have not brought your phone, driven your car, shown any distinguishing clothes or physical features to any security cameras en route or at location, and this assumes that your computer doesn't have a physical zero day exploit to begin with. So...it's tough.

Also, consider that on any high quality security camera, the FBI's facial recognition is a killer. Either way those are normal programs. If I had to hide THAT badly (as in I'm being hunted almost) then I'd have custom ways to hide myself on top of the proprietary ways.

Either way, I wanted a way to stay hidden when randomly doing things. I want to be anomalous even if no one cares who I am.

I may be wrong, but I get the impression that sliding off of corporate tracking via different methods like ad-blocking, NoScript, https, and VPNs begin to remove some of the latent data collected about your habits.
